title: Jensen Huang Urges US Japan South Korea AI Infrastructure Alliance
summary:
Nvidia's chief executive highlighted the complementary strengths of three key economies to accelerate the production of specialized semiconductors. Speaking alongside Senator Hagerty at the U.S.-Japan-South Korea Trilateral Dialogue, Jensen Huang argued that joint efforts in computing, memory and manufacturing are essential to build the next generation of AI infrastructure and create new industrial opportunities globally.

The event followed a ceremony where The Korea Society presented Huang with the 2026 Van Fleet Award for his role in strengthening relations between the U.S. and South Korea. Nvidia has maintained corporate and technical partnerships within South Korea for more than 25 years.
